content: International competitors (Deputy, Homebase, Buddy Punch, When I Work): all offer GPS geofencing + photo-on-punch as baseline. Geofence radius configurable (Buddy Punch 50-1500m, Deputy 100-1000m). Deputy adds biometric facial recognition + voice kiosk. Buddy Punch offers facial recognition matching (not just photo capture) plus real-time GPS breadcrumb tracking through the workday; Homebase only captures GPS at clock in/out, not continuously.
